AppFunctionAppMetadata.appfn:description: This tool allows management of the Android launcher home screen, also known as the workspace. It enables querying the current layout and performing actions like adding, removing, or moving items (apps, widgets, folders). The workspace consists of one or more screens and a hotseat bar. The functions available are: QUERY FUNCTIONS: - getCurrentWorkspace(): Returns the current layout of all screens and the hotseat, including item positions and grid dimensions (rows, columns). - getInstalledApps(): Returns a list of all installed apps on the device. - getInstalledWidgets(): Returns a list of all installed widgets on the device. Some of the functions have complex recipes that must be followed to ensure success. As part of verifying that the recipes were followed, a proof of invocation process is followed by requiring that the function receives the underlying proof from each dependent function call detailed in the recipe.
